tax_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) / ضريبة القيمة المضافة
legal_ref: VAT Law promulgated by Legislative Decree No. 48 of 2018, Art. 3(1) as replaced by Law No. 33 of 2021 (Arts. 3 and 5; OG No. 3572, 23 Dec 2021)
quote: “Tax shall be imposed at a standard rate of (10%) of the value of a supply or import, unless a specific provision is made in this Law to exempt from Tax or to impose Tax at a zero rate.” … Article Five: The provisions of Article Three of this law shall come into force on first January 2022. (LLOC English translation; Arabic Official Gazette prevails)
source_title: Legislation & Legal Opinion Commission (LLOC) – Law No. (33) of 2021 amending some provisions of the VAT Law promulgated by Legislative Decree No. (48) of 2018 (English)
notes: Rate raised from 5% (in force since 1 Jan 2019) to 10% from 1 Jan 2022; 5% continued for pre-existing contracts until expiry/amendment/renewal or one year (i.e. at latest 31 Dec 2022). Zero rate on exports, basic food items, healthcare, education, new buildings, local oil & gas, etc.; exemptions for certain financial services and real estate. Administered by the National Bureau for Revenue (nbr.gov.bh, which returned HTTP 403 to automated access). LLOC amendments page lists only Law 33/2021 as amending Decree-Law 48/2018.
